```{r Step 0: Pull in ANES Data, include=TRUE}
anes_panel <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "ANES_Data", "anes_timeseries_cdf_stata_20260205.dta"))
```

```{r Step 1: Cleaning Up the Dataset, include=TRUE}
# Check the variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(year = VCF0004, trust_gov_index = VCF0656, trust_gov = VCF0604, econ_views = VCF0870, stock_owns = VCF9224, social_class = VCF0149, person_finances = VCF0880, person_finances_scale = VCF0880a, personal_finances_next = VCF0881, age = VCF0101, age_group = VCF0102, gender = VCF0104, race = VCF0105a, educ = VCF0110, income_group = VCF0114, emp_status = VCF0116, homeowner = VCF0146, marital_stat = VCF0147, partisan_id = VCF0301, partisan_strength = VCF0305, pol_interest = VCF0310, union_mem = VCF0127)


#Initial Diagnostics
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_change = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~ as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    personal_finances_scale_factor = factor(
      personal_finances_change,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Much better",
        "Somewhat better",
        "Same",
        "Somewhat worse",
        "Much worse"
      )
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_scale_clean = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~
        as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~
        NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finance_direction = case_when(
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Better",
      personal_finances_scale_clean == 3 ~ "Same",
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Worse",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    personal_finance_direction = factor(
      personal_finance_direction,
      levels = c("Better", "Same", "Worse")
    )
  )
#Recoding Variables (Brought Over from Part 1)
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999)
  )

#Same Thing for Economic Views
anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) %>%
  count(econ_views, sort = TRUE)

#Recode Data to Only show valid entries
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999),
    econ_views = case_when(
      econ_views %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ econ_views,
      econ_views %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    # Trust
    trust_gov_index = if_else(
      trust_gov_index == 999,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(trust_gov_index)
    ),

    # Economic views
    econ_views = case_when(
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ as.numeric(econ_views),
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Stock ownership
    stock_owns = case_when(
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) %in% c(-8, -9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Homeownership
    homeowner = case_when(
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(homeowner) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Income percentile group
    income_group = as.numeric(income_group)
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    econ_views_factor = factor(
      econ_views,
      levels = c(1, 3, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Get better",
        "Stay about the same",
        "Get worse"
      )
    ),

    income_group_factor = factor(
      income_group,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "0–16th percentile",
        "17–33rd percentile",
        "34–67th percentile",
        "68–95th percentile",
        "96–100th percentile"
      )
    )
  )

#Adding in new variable - external efficacy index
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%

summary(anes_panel$efficacy_index)

table(

anes_panel %>%

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    government_care = VCF0609
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_care = case_when(
      as.numeric(government_care) %in% 1:3 ~ as.numeric(government_care),
      as.numeric(government_care) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    government_care_factor = factor(
      government_care,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c(
        "Agree",
        "Disagree",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    government_say = VCF0613
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_say = case_when(
      as.numeric(government_say) %in% 1:3 ~ as.numeric(government_say),
      as.numeric(government_say) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    government_say_factor = factor(
      government_say,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c(
        "Agree",
        "Disagree",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

table(
  anes_panel$government_say,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Affirmative action:
    # Higher values = stronger support
    affirmative_action = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 1 ~ 4,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 2 ~ 3,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 4 ~ 2,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 5 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 7 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    affirmative_action_factor = factor(
      affirmative_action,
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c(
        "Oppose strongly",
        "Oppose not strongly",
        "Favor not strongly",
        "Favor strongly"
      )
    ),
    
    # Black hardworking/lazy:
    # Reverse the original scale so higher = more hardworking
    black_hardworking = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF9271) %in% 1:7 ~
        8 - as.numeric(VCF9271),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    government_services = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0839) %in% 1:7 ~ as.numeric(VCF0839),
      as.numeric(VCF0839) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    government_jobs = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0809) %in% 1:7 ~ as.numeric(VCF0809),
      as.numeric(VCF0809) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

black_anes <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    race == 2,
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2024
  )


#Turn Dataset into Survey Object
anes_svy <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    ids = 1,
    weights = VCF0009z
  ) 

black_svy <- black_anes %>%

    ids = 1,

black_anes %>%
  count(year)

black_anes %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    stock_owners = sum(stock_owns == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    nonstock_owners = sum(stock_owns == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

black_anes %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    affirmative_action_n = sum(!is.na(affirmative_action)),

black_affirmative_descriptives <- black_anes %>%

    !is.na(affirmative_action),

  )

black_affirmative_descriptives

black_hardworking_descriptives <- black_anes %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(black_hardworking),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),

```


```{r Step 2: Initial Modeling on Affirmative Action and Hardworking Measures, include=TRUE}
black_anes %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(affirmative_action),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),
    !is.na(stock_owns)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_owns
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    outcome_sd = sd(affirmative_action, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(affirmative_action, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(affirmative_action, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_owns
  )

black_affirmative_svy_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(
    black_anes$year[
      black_anes$year >= 2000 &
      black_anes$year <= 2024
    ]
  )),
  function(y) {
    
    data_y <- black_anes %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(affirmative_action),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(stock_owns),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      affirmative_action ~
        income_group_factor * stock_owns,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    list(
      year = y,
      model = mod,
      n = nrow(data_y)
    )
  }
)

black_affirmative_interactions <- lapply(
  black_affirmative_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    broom::tidy(
      x$model,
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      filter(
        grepl(
          "^income_group_factor.*:stock_owns$",
          term
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(year)

black_affirmative_interactions

black_affirmative_predictions <- lapply(
  black_affirmative_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    income_levels <- levels(
      model.frame(x$model)$income_group_factor
    )
    
    marginaleffects::predictions(
      x$model,
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = income_levels,
        stock_owns = c(0, 1)
      )
    ) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        stock_group = factor(
          stock_owns,
          levels = c(0, 1),
          labels = c(
            "Non-stock owners",
            "Stock owners"
          )
        )
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

black_affirmative_predictions %>%
  select(
    year,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_group,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, stock_group, income_group_factor)

black_affirmative_joint_tests <- lapply(
  black_affirmative_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    mod <- x$model
    
    interaction_idx <- grep(
      "^income_group_factor.*:stock_owns$",
      names(coef(mod))
    )
    
    beta <- coef(mod)[interaction_idx]
    
    V <- vcov(mod)[interaction_idx, interaction_idx, drop = FALSE]
    
    W <- as.numeric(
      t(beta) %*% solve(V) %*% beta
    )
    
    q <- length(beta)
    
    F_stat <- W / q
    df_den <- mod$df.residual
    
    p_value <- pf(
      F_stat,
      df1 = q,
      df2 = df_den,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      year = x$year,
      n = x$n,
      F = F_stat,
      df_num = q,
      df_den = df_den,
      p.value = p_value
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(year)

black_affirmative_joint_tests

black_affirmative_predictions_plot <- ggplot(
  black_affirmative_predictions,
  aes(
    x = income_group_factor,
    y = estimate,
    group = stock_group,
    linetype = stock_group
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high,
      group = stock_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.12,
    linetype = 0
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Income percentile group",
    y = "Predicted support for affirmative action",
    linetype = "Stock ownership",
    title = "Income, stock ownership, and affirmative-action attitudes among Black respondents",
    subtitle = "Survey-weighted predictions by ANES wave"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

black_affirmative_predictions_plot

# ============================================================
# Original 5-category specification:
# Black respondents — Affirmative Action
# ============================================================

black_affirmative_predictions %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = income_group_factor,
      y = estimate,
      group = stock_group,
      linetype = stock_group
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",
    y = "Predicted affirmative-action support",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Affirmative-action attitudes by income and stock ownership",
    subtitle = "Black respondents, original five-category specification"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  here("05_images", "Affirmative_Action_Plot_Blacks.jpg"),
  plot = black_affirmative_predictions_plot
)
```
